purpose: LRM 4.6.4.3 noise_table: piecewise-linear PSD at tabulated and interior points

oracle.derivation: Every element is a VA device with no thermal noise, so the only generator is the noise_table current source on branch (out,0) of Nt. Vin is a short in the small-signal problem, so the transfer impedance at out is Rs||Rl = 1000||1000 = 500 ohm exactly, flat in frequency (no reactance in the deck). Output PSD = 500^2 * S_I(f) V^2/Hz and onoise_spectrum = 500*sqrt(S_I(f)) V/sqrt(Hz). Table knots (1e3,1e-18) (5e3,9e-18) (9e3,4e-18); LRM 4.6.4.3 interpolates S_I linearly in f. Segment 1 slope = (9e-18-1e-18)/4000 = 2e-21 per Hz: S_I(2000)=1e-18+2e-21*1000=3e-18, S_I(3000)=5e-18, S_I(4000)=7e-18. Segment 2 slope = (4e-18-9e-18)/4000 = -1.25e-21 per Hz: S_I(6000)=9e-18-1.25e-18=7.75e-18, S_I(7000)=6.5e-18, S_I(8000)=5.25e-18. Then 500*sqrt of each.
